title: Effects of Exposure to Active Minds’ Send Silence Packing Exhibit on College Students’ Mental Health Help-Seeking Intentions
summary_en: This study examined effects of exposure to a campus mental health promotion exhibit on changes in college students’ help-seeking intentions.
title_cn: Effects of Exposure to Active Minds’ Send Silence Packing Exhibit on College Students’ Mental Health Help-Seeking Intentions

title: Securing AI Algorithmic Insights
summary_en: In this report, the authors extend a security framework to provide the first systematic roadmap for protecting algorithmic insights, the novel techniques, methods, and design know-how that materially improve artificial intelligence systems.

title: Restricting AI Agent Use of Biological Tools: Exploring the Feasibility of Software Barriers
summary_en: AI agents can help non-experts use advanced biological design tools, raising misuse concerns. The authors explore safeguards built into biological tools that could block such assistance and find that their effectiveness is currently limited.
title_cn: Restricting AI Agent Use of Biological Tools: Exploring the Feasibility of Software Barriers
